hypothesis: R8 cookie-authenticated pinned-peer full handshakes are compared with TLS 1.3 full handshakes under identical closed-lab host, interface, MTU, payload, and lifecycle controls.

blocking.randomization: randomize mechanism order within each host-epoch block

trigger_and_readiness.start: authoritative child IPC attempt-start marker emitted after bounded setup and immediately before client userspace connect/send intent; marker carries child monotonic start and process-CPU baseline
trigger_and_readiness.complete: authenticated delivery and response of one application byte
trigger_and_readiness.readiness: completion condition is identical for both mechanisms; pre-marker setup is bounded and failures are setup failures

controls.R8: includes cookie processing and configured peer-pin verification
controls.TLS-1.3: full handshake only; resumption and 0-RTT disabled; preconfigured self-signed certificate and SPKI pin
controls.trust: preconfigured pins before trials; no trust-on-first-use or public PKI substitution

timeout_and_censoring.post_start_failure_evidence: For every timeout or error after the timed attempt starts, retain the authoritative child completion/failure snapshot on normal exit. Only killed, abnormal-exit, or unusable-output fallbacks retain elapsed monotonic time, child process CPU delta, and loopback counter delta through failure or kill/reap at the bounded deadline; supervisor CPU is never substituted.
timeout_and_censoring.setup_failures: Pre-marker setup failures or marker timeouts are retained with one error category prefixed setup: and zero timing, CPU, and network fields.
timeout_and_censoring.latency_censoring: Every non-success row after the attempt-start marker is a right-censored latency observation at its retained elapsed time.
timeout_and_censoring.failure_rate: All non-success rows contribute to failure rate over the complete measured denominator.
timeout_and_censoring.runtime_outcome: A full package labels runtime_outcome success exactly when its recomputed failure count is zero and failures-retained otherwise; a smoke package labels it smoke-non-result.

analysis.latency_quantile_rule: For each quantile q, use the earliest retained elapsed time at which the Kaplan-Meier estimated event CDF for success reaches q; report null when that threshold is not identifiable from right-censored rows.

bootstrap.nonestimable_rule: Report a null confidence interval when any deterministic block-bootstrap resample is nonestimable for that quantile.
